explication: Avenoxbeyin V3 is a local-first second brain for AI coding assistants: agents save and retrieve source-linked knowledge in an editable Markdown vault, with shared state across clients. The main workflow runs on client lifecycle events: the installed adapters invoke the local runtime, which refreshes vault indexing and supplies bounded context; agents can also record outcomes and tasks for later retrieval or recap. The README documents companion continuity, preferences, diagnostics, updates, and optional Jev/Laya advice. Several runtime links are based on documented behavior and module names; source excerpts are partial.
